item.title: U.S. Marines Arrive in Middle East, as Houthis Enter War
item.summary: A U.S. official said that earlier an Iranian strike at a military base in Saudi Arabia injured around two dozen U.S. troops, one of the most serious breaches of American defenses since the war began.

item.title: Israeli Strike Kills 3 Journalists in Southern Lebanon, Officials Say
item.summary: Israel accused one of the reporters of being a Hezbollah operative. Lebanon’s president said they were journalists and condemned the killings.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis Fire at Israel and Vow Further Attacks
item.summary: There has long been concern that the Houthis, an Iran-backed militia, could disrupt shipping in the Red Sea if they entered the broader war.

item.title: Ukraine Finalizes Air Defense Deals With Gulf Nations Amid War in Mideast
item.summary: The Ukrainian president visited the Middle East, where he sought to shift his country from a recipient of military aid to a supplier.

item.title: Airstrikes batter a university and residential zones in Tehran.
Pakistan Set to Host Top Regional Diplomats for Talks on Iran War
item.summary: The foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Egypt are expected in Islamabad on Sunday as the Pakistani government strives to find a diplomatic solution to the war.

item.title: Can This Russian Bakery Survive a 3,500% Tax Increase?
item.summary: The challenges faced by a small-business owner near Moscow highlight how Russia’s war-drained economy is on the doorstep of a major crisis.

item.title: UAE and Qatar Arrest Hundreds Over Online Videos of Iranian Attacks
item.summary: The authorities have made a wave of arrests to stop people posting footage of strikes, citing security risks. Experts also see a fear of damage to the countries’ image as safe havens.

item.title: A Toothless Iran? Missile and Drone Strikes Show It Can Still Inflict Pain.
item.summary: A wave of strikes across the Middle East in recent days shows that Iran has not lost the capacity to retaliate.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: The war with Iran escalated on Saturday as the Iran-allied Houthis joined the conflict and Israel bombarded Tehran with airstrikes.
